text: The financial action is performed by Reactive Omni.
An ordinary supported token payment reaches the existing user-owned vault.
The Reactive contract observes the exact Transfer event and requests an authenticated callback.
The vault checks the official provider and its authorized Reactive sender, prevents duplicate payouts, and applies the owner's current allocation rules.
The two new test payments together distribute fifty tokens, thirty tokens, and twenty tokens.
No backend wallet triggers the split.
